evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Contrasts owned vs. rented as a proportionality distinction — value retained vs. value leased — enacting market-pricing logic without hierarchy or communal pooling.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Labels perspective as an asset to keep, framing relational value in cost-benefit terms — what to retain vs. what is disposable commodity.
